amended_rule: A valid native catalogue source need not own any exclusive derived pixels. Retain its native source and component records and use support_label=null when no pixels are won.
approval: Scientific owner approved the proposed explicit unavailable-support adapter contract and corresponding tests in this task.
preserved_rules: Every modelled native island pixel retains exactly its original model-dominance winner and stable native-key tie break.
Native source positions, fluxes, source/component membership and all catalogue denominators remain unchanged.
Fitless native islands remain published without invented catalogue rows.
Positive support labels assert actual pixels; missing asserted labels and corrupt native membership still fail closed.
Unavailable support supplies no overlap evidence. The existing centre-in-one-beam-dilation matching clause is unchanged.
Unmatched native rows remain in reliability and catalogue counts. Topology summaries describe only actual support and explicitly disclose unavailable source support.
Truth, populations, thresholds, margins, confidence rules, comparator identities and gates are unchanged. PyBDSF is never treated as truth.
scope: R6 retained-source projection and validation compiler schema; not finder science
